messages:
sarah: Quick sync — we're rolling out an audit event schema update (v1.4) that adds KMS telemetry + RBAC action vectors. Need a short customer-facing validation guide, changelog blurb, and an internal validator before canary. Who can own docs + validator?

tom: I can own the validator CLI + infra tests. carol want me to pair on the example snippets? @carol

carol: Yup, I can write the examples + changelog. Will need sample events and migration notes. Keep language minimal for customers.

ravi: Schema diff (high level):
```json
- event.schema.version: v1.3
+ event.schema.version: v1.4
+ fields added: ["kms_key_id", "kms_operation", "rbac_changeset_id", "auth_context"]
+ kms fields nullable, string, maxLen=200
```
Small note: auth_context is an object with masked principals; we'll include a redaction guideline.

jason: For KMS: we'll populate kms_key_id (ARN-like string) and kms_operation (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign/Verify). Confirming these are non-sensitive; we should NOT log plaintext keys or material. Put a redaction line in docs: `do_not_log: key_material`

audit-bot: Schema v1.4 registered in staging (schema-registry.internal/redwood/audit/v1.4). Tests: 42/42 schema validations passing. :white_check_mark:

len: RBAC changes: new permission `audit:export` and action vector `rbac.changeset.apply`. Update RBAC matrix + admin console roles. Also add this to oncall playbook: if audit exports occur off-hours escalate to security@redwood.

tom: Validator plan: add `tools/audit-validate` CLI with commands:
```bash
# validate against v1.4 schema
audit-validate validate --schema v1.4 sample_event.json
# run quick suite
audit-validate test --cases=v1.4-smoke
```
Will add CI gate that fails deploy if new events emitted to prod don't match v1.4 when feature flag on.

sarah: Owners/next steps:
- tom: build validator + CI (due EOD 3/23)
- carol: customer-facing changelog + docs snippet (draft by 3/24)
- jason: confirm no PII in new fields + KMS SDK version check (please open PR/ticket)
- ravi: create migration notes + sample events (3/24)
- len: RBAC matrix + playbook update (3/25)

ops-bot: Canary rollout job created: canary-audit-v1.4 -> schedule 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z. Monitoring: audit-schema-alerts + perf metrics.

carol: Draft for customers (first-pass):
"We are introducing additional audit fields to improve visibility into key usage and permission changes. These fields are backwards-compatible and optional. See our validation tool and schema docs for examples. If you run a custom audit pipeline, run `audit-validate` against v1.4 before enabling the new flags."

ravi: Vulnerability check: no CVE found for our KMS client but noticed we are on kms-client v2.1.4 — v2.1.6 has a patch for memoization bug that could leak cache keys. Opening ticket #789 to bump and test.

tom: One more ask — include a tiny sample event in docs showing redaction guidelines. e.g.
```json
{
  "event_type": "kms.operation",
  "actor": "service-account:ingest",
  "resource": "projects/prod/keys/ak-123",
  "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/ak-123",
  "kms_operation": "Encrypt",
  "outcome": "success",
  "request_id": "req_01H...",
  "auth_context": "[REDACTED]"
}
```

sarah: Perfect. After drafts are in, we'll run a customer-facing validation job and send a short changelog email with opt-out instructions for customers who need extra time. Thanks all — update the thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:
